text:
maria.support: FYI multiple paying customers flagged subtle behavior changes after last night's rollout. Replies are shorter and sometimes drop the second bullet. Suspect chat-template or tokenizer tweak. Example below.

jake.engineering: thanks — can you paste a minimal repro and which model + variant? also any customer IDs you can share privately? :pray:

maria.support: quick repro (redacted customer conv id):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-001","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant. Use concise bullets."},{"role":"user","content":"List 3 risks of introducing a new third-party dependency to production."}]}'
```

maria.support: Expected (from historical logs):
- Increased maintenance overhead
- Potential licensing issues
- Security exposure

maria.support: Observed after rollout: only first bullet returned, then ellipsis or a short sentence. Example returned text: "1) Increased maintenance overhead..." and then stops.

sam.prod-ml: did we change the chat template prefix or system message normalization in the push? I remember a small trimming fix to avoid overly long system prompts.

deploy-bot: Rolled out: chat-template-v2 to canary and 50% traffic at 2026-02-28T23:40Z. No tokenizer config changes in that release (per release notes), but template now strips trailing whitespace and normalizes newlines.

jake.engineering: can you paste the raw request/response token counts? need to know if KV cache or tokenization difference is dropping content.

maria.support: from customer logs (sanitized):
- request.tokens: 48
- response.tokens: 22 on rollout day (should be ~78 in prior weeks)

maria.support: also ran local diff: when system content ends with "\n\n" previous runtime kept an extra newline token, new runtime collapses to single newline and summary generation stops early.

sam.prod-ml: aha — so template normalization reduced the prefix token footprint but somehow changed where the model thinks the user content starts. Could alter alignments for instruction-following.

jake.engineering: low-effort repro for infra team: swap templates locally and compare model generation length. If it's deterministic, we can A/B test on canary and measure token counts and ROUGE on evaluation prompts.

maria.support: customer wants urgency. They're on a reserved Dedicated plan. Can we prioritize rollback to 20% and route affected customers?

dave.ops: I can rollback canary to chat-template-v1 for 30 mins and route those dedicated customers back. Need a list of customer IDs from support.

maria.support: sending IDs via secure DM now.

sam.prod-ml: I'll reproduce locally with quantized and full-precision variants. Also will run tokenizer debug to show token sequence boundary for system->user joiner.

jake.engineering: thanks. Next steps: (1) ops rollback to 20% for sensitive customers, (2) ml to run token-boundary diffs + small eval set, (3) support to collect 3 canonical customer examples and affected models. Ping once we have token diffs.

maria.support: noted. will update customers and mark as P1 until resolved. :white_check_mark:
